title: COEP reflection

labels.name: topic: cross-origin-embedder-policy
labels.description: Issues and ideas around the new "require CORP for subresource requests and frames and etc" proposal

body: ### Original proposal https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7912 ### Description This adds: ```js self.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy ``` It reflects the environment's [cross-origin-embedder-policy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/origin.html#coep)'s value. ### Security/Privacy It is already possible to deduce the value returned by the API, by making a `fetch` toward a known cross-origin URL responding with the request's cookies and no CORS header. It is costly, but theoretically polyfillable. As such, it should be a security/privacy no-op. ### Motivation Depending on the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value, not every iframe/subresources can be loaded inside the document. If this reflection API is provided, 3rd party scripts can take better decisions. They can implement fallbacks. In particular, for trying [Anonymous Iframe](https://github.com/WICG/anonymous-iframe), Google DisplayAds, needs a way to know the COEP policy. The Ads's script could this way be able to decide in between inserting a normal or an anonymous iframe. ---- - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chrome: interested [chromestatus](https://chromestatus.com/feature/5074103873568768) * Webkit: not opposed. Alex Christensen replied ["Seems reasonable"](https://lists.webkit.org/pipermail/webkit-dev/2022-June/032259.html). I don't know if this is considered "official". * Mozilla: Looks reasonable [link](https://github.com/mozilla/standards-positions/issues/645#issuecomment-1160546542). - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/34141 * /html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/reflection-unsafe-none.tentative.https.any.js * /html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/reflection-credentialless.tentative.https.any.js * /html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/reflection-require-corp.tentative.https.any.js - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: https://crbug.com/1324521 * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1774447 * Safari: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=230550 * Deno: N/A * Node.js: N/A (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /webappapis.html ( diff )
